description: The Data Bank of India's Petroleum and Natural Gas Regulatory Board collects the regulator's data sheets and maps under one page, grouped as Monthly Bulletin, Monthly NGPL MIS, Monthly PPPL MIS, Monthly CGD MIS, Monthly CGD Progress Report, a presentation on CGD infrastructure, PNG and CNG activities, natural gas sales by city gas distribution companies, and separate lists for natural gas pipelines, city gas distribution networks and petroleum product pipelines. The regulator authorises the pipelines and city gas networks, so these sheets are the official source for the state of gas and product pipeline projects and CGD geographical areas in India. Access: the page is open and free; the tables of files load dynamically, so the individual sheet names, dates and formats were not visible to the page reader, and no licence is stated. Coverage is national. Caveats: the file listings could not be read, so contents and periods are inferred from the section headings. It suits capacity planning and network studies of Indian gas and fuel pipelines, and relates to the NGPL India transmission network reconstruction catalogued here.
